purpose: Machine-readable historical defect backfill for the governance-stabilization window: every real reviewer finding that established a canonical recurring-defect family, classified, deduplicated, and bound to its four protection layers (canonical family entry, regression test, applicability selector, enforcement gate). Only confirmed real defects carry coverage; duplicates map to the one family that already guards them; false positives, style findings, and out-of-scope dispositions are recorded for the audit trail and explicitly excluded from coverage.

records.source_reference: Codex inline review comment 3967220252 on src/hunter/evidence_intelligence/engineering_task_ingress.py (post-merge P1 tracked as Issue #439)
records.original_defect: Dispatchability was measured by the raw UTF-8 size of caller task text alone, but the machine re-encodes that text and renders additional prompt material, so a rendered outcome could be ranked READY beyond the basis of the caller's raw guard.
